raw_segments.text: It's impossible they'll both be released.
To begin with, the whole story contradicts itself.
Why should they have called the porter if it had been their doing?
No, that would be too cunning.
Besides, Pestriakov, the student, was seen at the gate by both the porters and a woman
He was walking with three friends, who left him only at the gate, and he asked the porters
to direct him, in the presence of the friends.
Now, would he have asked his way if he had been going with such an object?
As for Kok, he spent half an hour at the silversmiths below, before he went up to the old woman
and he left him at exactly a quarter to eight.
